messages:
Claire: Quick UX check on the contextual docs drawer we shipped in staging. Two things: inconsistent label text and awkward navigation when the drawer link opens the docs in the same tab.
Raj: Saw that. Some places say 'Guides', others 'Docs'. Users get confused which destination theyre going to.
Priya: I prefer 'Docs' (matches docs.redwood.inference) but happy to add 'Guides' as a category inside docs.
Anita: Accessibility: the drawer traps focus but the close control reads as 'button' only. Also header not semantic. Need small a11y fixes.
Claire: Proposal: unify label to 'Docs' in console strings, make drawer links open docs in a new tab, and deep-link into docs sections so context is preserved. Also update CTA copy to say '(opens in new tab)'.
Raj: New-tab sounds right. Current behavior loses console state. Tooltip should say 'Opens docs in a new tab'.
Priya: On deep links, docs team needs stable anchor ids. Example link format suggestion:
https://docs.redwood.inference/guides/routing#policy-fallbacks?from=console
That lets docs show a small banner: 'Viewing from Redwood Console  Back to console'.
Anita: Accessibility checklist I'll paste in the PR:
- close button: aria-label="Close help drawer"
- header: use <h2> not div
- focus restores to triggering element on close
- icon buttons: aria-describedby and 44px interactive target
- focus ring contrast meets AA
Claire: Nice checklist. Also microcopy: avoid mixing 'Docs' and 'Guides' in labels. If we add a folder inside docs called 'Guides', that's fine, but console UI should use 'Docs' everywhere.
docs-bot: automated: found 3 console strings with 'Guides' (ui/help_drawer.title, ui/help_cta.label, ui/route_quickhelp.link_text).
Priya: I'll ask docs team for anchor naming and add the console_return param behavior.
Raj: Implementation notes: front-end will add target=_blank + rel=noopener and append ?from=console to deep links. We'll also add a tiny tooltip and change CTA text.
Anita: Please include unit tests asserting aria-label presence and keyboard focus behavior.
Claire: Action items: Priya -> docs anchors + banner; Raj -> copy changes + new-tab behavior; Anita -> a11y checklist and tests; me -> update design spec and list of strings. Target: finish in this sprint.
Raj: I'll open the PR tonight and tag reviewers.
Priya: I'll ping the docs team now.
Anita: I'll attach the a11y checklist to the PR and run quick keyboard testing.
Claire: Thanks all 44d. Please post PR links here when ready.
